messages:
liz: Quick heads-up — target release tonight 22:00 UTC. build/4723 includes a late bump of protobuf -> 1.2.3. SBOM step flagged a transitive vuln (CVE-2025-1234, low). Change is small but late. Need decision: pin back to 1.2.2 + note, or proceed with limited canary and hotfix tomorrow? @sam @kevin

deploy-bot: SBOM scan: artifact build-4723
- CVE: CVE-2025-1234 (transitive)
- Severity: Low
- Provenance: signed
- Fixed-in-upstream: 1.2.4 (not released yet)
Pipeline: tests green, canary infra healthy

sam: Thanks. Low severity but exploitability unknown. Can you paste the SBOM path? If it's only dev toolchain we can proceed. Also need legal sign-off? @kevin

alex: SBOM path: protobuf -> pkg-xyz -> lib-unsafe. It's only used in internal protos for telemetry serialization. No customer-facing surface. Repro: `grep -R "lib-unsafe" -n` in repo shows only telemetry/serializer. Unit + integration tests cover serializer.

jordan: QA: ran quick smoke against staging canary build-4723 — no regression in api or auth flows. latency unchanged.

tanvi: Ops: change window is tight. If we do limited canary, restrict to eu-west-1 and throttle to 5% traffic. Will need deploy-bot override.

kevin: Product: Customers using telemetry SDKs? Any chance a schema break could affect clients? If not, prefer canary and call out in release notes.

sam: Recommend limited canary + release note with CVE mention + monitoring alert on telemetry error rate. Roll back on any spike. Also create a follow-up task to pin/upgrade when upstream fixes.

liz: Actionable: (1) canary eu-west-1 @22:00, 5% traffic (2) release notes blurb: 'Known: transitive low-severity CVE in internal telemetry lib — no customer impact observed in staging' (3) open ticket to pin or upgrade when 1.2.4 is out. @deploy-bot please schedule canary with override: `./deploy --artifact build-4723 --region eu-west-1 --traffic 5% --override force-gate`

deploy-bot: Override scheduled: deploy-4723-canary -> eu-west-1 @2025-06-12T22:00Z, 5% traffic. Rollback hook: rollback-if telemetry_error_rate > 1% for 15m.

liz: :thumbsup: Thanks. Sam, Kevin — consider this the approval unless you object in 20m.

sam: No objection. I'll monitor alerts and stand by.

kevin: Agree.

alex: I'll open the follow-up PR to pin/upgrade and add the release-notes blurb.

jordan: I'll watch canary and post results in this thread.
